# leak-lint exact-text allowlist.
#
# Format: each non-comment, non-blank line is the EXACT stripped text of one line that
# leak_lint.py would otherwise flag. Never a line number -- line numbers rot the moment the
# surrounding file is edited. Add an entry only for a genuine historical record (e.g. a
# completed changelog entry documenting a fix by name), never to silence a live leak -- an
# allowlist seeded with real drift teaches the next person the lint is advisory.
